sources.snippet: (c) In Raw2Drive, we propose the first feasible model-based reinforcement learning paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. By leveraging low-dimensional, structured privileged input, our approach guides the learning of a world model from raw sensor data, effectively addressing the issues outlined in (a) and (b).
